authorizationNote: Bounded production Admin-login incident repair. PR #732 fixed the Vercel BFF identity/IP boundary and PR #733 restored the database nonce RPC authority, but canonical production still returns admin_bff_replay_protection_unavailable while direct database nonce claims succeed. This PR binds the canonical Admin BFF nonce claim, Staff pre-auth and authentication throttles, authorization lookup/activation, Auth metadata administration and bootstrap reads to one exact client created from Supabase's built-in SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. The publishable-key password Auth client and browser session contract remain separate and unchanged. Other runtimes retain support for valid Supabase sb_secret keys; this entrypoint-local isolation only removes ambiguous or stale generic-key selection from the Admin BFF login path. No browser credential, Business behavior, database schema, secret value, Vercel configuration or direct production deployment is authorized by this manifest.
